description: List the Valet organizations the account belongs to, sorted by name, with the one every tool uses when you omit org_name marked as the default. Each organization shows your role in it (admin or developer), its member count, and its pending invitation count. Pass include with members, invitations, or both to also list the members (email, name, role, and when they joined) and the pending invitations (email, when sent, and when they expire). Pass org_name to list one organization. Use the names here as org_name on the other tools. Invitation codes are never shown. Requires connecting a Valet account.

include.description: Lists to include for each organization. Omit for counts only.

org_name.description: List only this Valet organization. Omit to list every organization the account belongs to.

name: list_orgs
title: List organizations
